title: querylog.py export prints the store and the ops rows as one record format
goal: querylog.py export --format jsonl [--since DAY] [--event E] prints entries, findings, usage, work and ops rows as records shaped like an OpenTelemetry log record (timestamp, severity, event name, record id, resource, closed attributes, null body) without changing the store's own files; read-time redaction drops unknown keys, checks each value's shape and runs the leak scan, and omits the question text unless asked.

gates.question: This adds a mechanism before a failure it answers has happened (backlog.md, Changing this process). Add it anyway?

Record shape of the export: snake_case field names, severity WARN for a refused done, a nonzero ops exit and an apply-failed finding (else INFO), resource service.name and kb.run, event names entry.<surface>, finding.<kind>, usage, work.<kind>, ops.<event>, and a --store option beside the listed flags?
options: OTLP-JSON field names and one flat event namespace

notes: No endpoint is built: observability tools read the exported JSON Lines, and an OTLP-JSON form is added only when the operator names a tool that needs it. The command needs an allow rule in .claude/settings.json (BG-oi6mrxvr).
